subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Chaos
solution:
The correct answer is "**Disarray**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ​The given word **"Chaos" **refers to a state of complete disorder or confusion. (अराजकता)
 
• Example: After the sudden announcement, there was **chaos **in the streets as people scrambled to get home.
 
• The correct synonym **"Disarray" **stands for a state of disorganization or untidiness. (अव्यवस्था)
 
 
• Example: The library books were in total **disarray **after the children's visit.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3". **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Insanity: This term refers to the state of being seriously mentally ill; madness. (पागलपन)
 
 
• Example: Claims of the king's insanity were exaggerated by his rivals.
 
 
 
• Tidiness: This represents the quality of being neat and arranged in an orderly manner. (सफाई)
 
 
• Example: The tidiness of her desk indicated her meticulous nature.
 
 
 
• Certainty: This is the state of being completely confident or having no doubt about something. (निश्चितता)
 
 
• Example: Despite the chaos around him, he had a certainty that things would improve.
